# tAge Replication

## #1 Load Packages

```{r}
library(reticulate)
library(tAge)
library(Biobase)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(readxl)
```

## #2 Python and Directories

```{r}
reticulate::py_require(c("joblib", "pandas", "scikit-learn", "numpy"))
```

## #3 Import Data

### Expression

```{r}
expression=read.csv(here("data","raw","Expression_data_absolute_rodents_Scaled.csv"),
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
```

### Metadata

Tabela só com ITPs

```{r}
metadata <- read.csv(here("results","table_Zenodo.csv"),
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
)
```

## #4 Common Samples

### Select Common Samples

```{r}
common = intersect(colnames(expression),rownames(metadata))
paste0(length(common)," samples in common")
```

### Discard Different Samples

```{r}
expression <- expression[, common]
metadata <- metadata[common, ]
```

## #5 Create Expression Set

```{r}
eset = make_ExpressionSet(
  expression,
  metadata
)
```

## #6 Gene alignment and subtracting control values

### Gene Alignment

```{r}
gene_list <- tAge:::load_gene_list()

e <- tAge:::.align_to_gene_list(eset, gene_list)
```

### Subtract_controls function

```{r}
control_column <- "Intervention"
control_label  <- "Control"

subtract_controls <- function(eset, control_col, control_lab) {
  mat <- Biobase::exprs(eset)
  is_control <- Biobase::pData(eset)[[control_col]] %in% control_lab
  control_median <- apply(mat[, is_control, drop = FALSE], 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
  Biobase::exprs(eset) <- mat - control_median
  eset
}
```

### Control Subtraction

```{r}
eset_by_group <- list(All_Controls = subtract_controls(e, control_column, control_label))
groups <- list(All_Controls = NULL)
```

### Subtract Controls from Expected_Hazard.log10

```{r}
center_controls <- function(values, meta, control_col, control_lab) {
  is_control <- meta[[control_col]] %in% control_lab
  values - median(values[is_control], na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

## #7 Find the Models

```{r}
model_dir <- here("data","raw")

model_files <- list.files(model_dir, pattern = "\\.pkl$", full.names = TRUE)
basename(model_files)
```

### Confirm that the models are linear

```{r}
r <- rnorm(nrow(exprs(e)))

e2 <- e
exprs(e2) <- exprs(e) - r

for (model_path in model_files) {
  
    p1 <- predict_tAge(list(scaled_diff=e),  list(scaled_diff=model_path), species="mouse", mode="EN")
    p2 <- predict_tAge(list(scaled_diff=e2), list(scaled_diff=model_path), species="mouse", mode="EN")
    
    delta <- p1$scaled_diff_EN_tAge - p2$scaled_diff_EN_tAge
    
  cat(basename(model_path), ":", sd(delta), "\n")
}
```

## #8 Run the Models

```{r}
models       <- c("Mortality_Rodents_Liver",
                  "Mortality_Mouse_Multitissue",
                  "Mortality_Rodents_Multitissue")
expected_col <- "Expected_Hazard.log10"
group_name   <- "All_Controls"

e_sub    <- eset_by_group[[group_name]]
meta_sub <- Biobase::pData(e_sub)

# Identify the 11 young control samples
young_controls <- meta_sub$Intervention == "Control" &
  meta_sub$Age.days < 660

stopifnot(sum(young_controls, na.rm = TRUE) == 11)

results_list <- list()

for (model_name in models) {
  
  model_path <- model_files[
    grepl(model_name, basename(model_files), fixed = TRUE)
  ]
  
  if (length(model_path) != 1) {
    warning(model_name, ": ", length(model_path),
            " matching files, skipped")
    next
  }
  
  pred <- predict_tAge(
    list(scaled_diff = e_sub),
    list(scaled_diff = model_path),
    species = "mouse",
    mode = "EN"
  )
  
  pred_cols <- setdiff(colnames(pred), colnames(meta_sub))
  pred_col  <- pred_cols[!grepl("_sd$", pred_cols)][1]
  
  stopifnot(all(colnames(e_sub) %in% rownames(pred)))
  
  obtained <- as.numeric(pred[colnames(e_sub), pred_col])
  
  expected <- center_controls(
    as.numeric(meta_sub[[expected_col]]),
    meta_sub,
    control_column,
    control_label
  )
  
  difference <- obtained - expected
  
  # Pearson correlation using all 161 samples
  r_161 <- cor(
    obtained, expected,
    use = "complete.obs",
    method = "pearson"
  )
  
  # Pearson correlation excluding the 11 young controls
  keep <- !young_controls
  
  r_150 <- cor(
    obtained[keep], expected[keep],
    use = "complete.obs",
    method = "pearson"
  )
  
  block <- data.frame(
    Obtained            = obtained,
    Expected_Centered   = expected,
    Difference          = difference,
    Mean_Abs_Difference = NA_real_,
    Max_Abs_Difference  = NA_real_,
    SD_Difference       = NA_real_,
    Pearson_161         = NA_real_,
    Pearson_150         = NA_real_,
    Spearman            = NA_real_,
    row.names           = colnames(e_sub)
  )
  
  block$Mean_Abs_Difference[1] <- mean(abs(difference), na.rm = TRUE)
  block$Max_Abs_Difference[1]  <- max(abs(difference), na.rm = TRUE)
  block$SD_Difference[1]       <- sd(difference, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  block$Pearson_161[1] <- r_161
  block$Pearson_150[1] <- r_150
  
  block$Spearman[1] <- cor(
    obtained, expected,
    use = "complete.obs",
    method = "spearman"
  )
  
  names(block) <- paste(model_name, names(block), sep = "__")
  
  results_list[[paste(group_name, model_name, sep = "__")]] <- block
}
```

## #9 Results Table

```{r}
aligned_blocks <- lapply(results_list, function(b) {
  out <- b[rownames(metadata), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
})

expected_centered <- center_controls(
  as.numeric(metadata[["Expected_Hazard.log10"]]),
  metadata,
  control_column,
  control_label
)

results_table <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(metadata),
  metadata,
  Expected_Hazard.log10_centered = expected_centered,
  " " = NA,
  do.call(cbind, unname(aligned_blocks)),
  check.names = FALSE,
  row.names = NULL
)

write.csv(results_table,
          here("experiments","replication","tAge_replication_results.csv"),
          na="",
          row.names= FALSE
)
```

## #10 Graphs

```{r}
plot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(aligned_blocks), function(key) {
  
  parts <- strsplit(key, "__", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  block <- aligned_blocks[[key]]
  
  data.frame(
    Control_Group = parts[1],
    Model    = parts[2],
    Sample   = rownames(metadata),
    Obtained = block[[paste(parts[2], "Obtained", sep = "__")]],
    Expected = block[[paste(parts[2], "Expected_Centered", sep = "__")]],
    Lab      = metadata$Lab
  )
}))

panel_stats <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  split(plot_data, list(plot_data$Control_Group, plot_data$Model),
        drop = TRUE),
  function(d) {
    
    young_controls <- metadata$Intervention == "Control" &
      metadata$Age.days < 660
    
    keep <- !young_controls
    
    data.frame(
      Control_Group = d$Control_Group[1],
      Model = d$Model[1],
      label = sprintf(
        "R (n=161) = %.2f\nR (n=150) = %.2f",
        cor(d$Obtained, d$Expected, use = "complete.obs"),
        cor(d$Obtained[keep], d$Expected[keep], use = "complete.obs")
      )
    )
  }
))

scatter_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Expected, y = Obtained, colour = Lab)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_text(
    data = panel_stats,
    aes(label = label),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(Control_Group ~ Model) +
  labs(
    x = "Expected hazard (log10)",
    y = "Obtained hazard (log10)",
    title = "Obtained vs expected hazard by control group and model"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

scatter_plot

ggsave(
  here("experiments", "replication", "tAge_scatterplots.png"),
  scatter_plot,
  width = 14, height = 11, dpi = 300
)
```

## #11 Calculate Standard Deviation by Group

As Expected_Hazard.log10 refer to the expected values (calculated from the Gompertz model), the standard deviation values from samples with the same sex, cohort, lab, age and intervention should be 0.

```{r}
groups_sd=paste(metadata$Cohort,metadata$Sex,metadata$Lab,metadata$Age.days,metadata$Intervention,sep="_")
intermediate_table=data.frame(Expected_mortality.log10=metadata$Expected_Hazard.log10, groups_sd=groups_sd)
rownames(intermediate_table)=rownames(metadata)

v=tapply(intermediate_table$Expected_mortality.log10, intermediate_table$groups_sd, sd)
summary(v)
```
